_stamp: [2026-10-24 05:58 PM Johnny Chu - Chu Hoàng Anh] PHASE-0.133 S133-Ma (doc 81, R-ENTRY-META EM-1…7, D133-M1…M6) — what can be READ about one journal row (metadata.meta), the search text built from it (column find_text) and the one read shape every UI renders (entry-card@1). Runtime JSON (core/kg-hub/contracts): code = BizCity_Journal_Entry_Meta; docs/ is never read at runtime.
write_door: journal.meta.set (MCP, cell: source cell_auto | cell_tool) · POST journal/{id}/meta (REST, a person: source owner_edit, locks the fields it changes) · document.summary.set (shortcut ⇒ about)
strict: unknown top-level key ⇒ entry_meta_invalid (400, fields[], hint, help_code); over a limit ⇒ the same; never silently cut on the strict door

about.note: what this is, in one or two sentences

caption.note: the words the sender typed with the file

locked.note: fields a person fixed; automatic passes skip them (EM-4)

rev.note: +1 on every write; expected_rev stale ⇒ entry_meta_conflict (409)

find_text: title · meta.title · about · summary · caption · OCR (≤ 4000) · keywords · topics · entities · people · visible card fields, joined with ' | ', then ' || ' + the folded copy (no diacritics, đ→d); ≤ 12000 chars; built by the site, never sent

find_v2.result: items sorted by score, each with why[] and score; SQL narrows ≤ 200 rows first

card_view: journal-kinds@1.6.0 kinds[*].card_view [{key, label, type: text|long_text|money|number|date|datetime|enum|person|list|link|count|items, enum?, currency_key?}] + hide[]; internal keys always hidden: as_of, seen, session, summary_by, summary_at, confidence, prev_card, mirror, items, messages_raw, version_family, version_parent

card.door: GET journal/{id}?view=card (REST, preview link signed only with file.get) · journal.get {view: card} (MCP, no link)

candidates.decide: POST journal/{id}/candidates/{cid} {decision: approve|reject} — approve books the target row (derived_from + origin.page_anchor, idempotency cand:<entry>:<cid>); a candidate is never a booked row by itself (SF-5)
